Follow .github/copilot-instructions.md.
Build features/skills and features/experience.
Skills: grouped glass cards from skillGroups, Stagger entrance, chip hover animation, plus a Marquee of core tech.
Experience: vertical timeline whose line draws on scroll (scaleY with useScroll). Each role is a GlassCard
revealing from alternating sides on desktop, stacked on mobile: company, role, dates, responsibilities,
achievements (highlighted), tech tags. Show 'Present' for the current role.
